The wood grain texture is somewhat uniform and lacks the fine detail and variation expected in real wood, appearing slightly plastic-like or digitally smoothed.
The geometry of the rear sight aperture and the carrying handle seems slightly warped, with non-parallel lines that don't fully align with the rest of the receiver's perspective.
